Control all your smart lights from one app! Compatible with Philip's Hues, Nanoleafs, LIFX, and arduinos!

Corluma provides users with multiple color pickers and palettes to quickly choose the exact right color for your lights. For lights that support it, Corluma can also create and access lighting routines that change colors over time. Do you have too many lights? Simplify managing them by grouping them and controlling them all at once. Did you spend a lot of time getting your lights to look just right? You can save light settings and set them back to their exact state at a later date with just a few clicks.

Corluma does not require an account, external servers, or additional permissions such as location to use your lights. All communication is done on local wifi.


All Hues and all LIFX lights are supported. For Nanoleafs, all lights except the Nanoleaf Essentials line are supported. For arduinos, Corluma is compatible with the ArduCor sketch which is compatible with NeoPixels, Rainbowduinos, and standard LEDs. It supports connecting to arduino yuns over HTTP or UDP.
